question: A can lay railway track between two given stations in 19 days and B can do the same job in 15 days. With the help of C, they did the job in 3 days only. Then, C alone can do the job in
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = **LCM** of (19, 15, 3) = **855 units**.

Efficiency of **A** = 855 ÷ 19 = **45**; Efficiency of **B** = 855 ÷ 15 = **57**.

Efficiency of **A + B + C** = 855 ÷ 3 = **285**.

Efficiency of **C** = 285 − (45 + 57) = **183**.

Time for **C** = 855 ÷ 183 = 285 ÷ 61 = **4(41/61) days**.

**∴ The correct answer is 4(41/61) days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Time taken by **A** = 19 days, **B** = 15 days, **A+B+C** = 3 days.

⇒ Total combined efficiency of **A, B and C** = 285 units/day.

⇒ Efficiency of **C** = (A + B + C) efficiency − (A + B) efficiency

⇒ Efficiency of **C** = 285 − (45 + 57) = 285 − 102 = 183 units/day.

⇒ Time taken by **C** alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of C

⇒ Time = 855 ÷ 183

⇒ Time = 285 ÷ 61 = 4(41/61) days.

**∴ The correct answer is 4(41/61) days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Efficiency Relation

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time taken. Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time.

Combined Work Formula

If C helps A and B, the equation is 1/A + 1/B + 1/C = 1/Total Time.

Time & Wages

Wages are always distributed in the ratio of the **efficiency** of the workers if they work for the same duration.</p
